name: Inspect

guide.summary: Tap an organism or a cell to see what is happening there.
guide.biology: Looking closely at single cells under a microscope shows what they are doing. Here every value comes from the game’s own records.
guide.rules: The inspector shows an organism’s health, energy, body, age, what it is doing, what it can eat there and up to three measured limits, or a cell’s ground, amounts, pH, salinity, oxygen and light. Every line comes from a recorded value or reason. Inspecting never changes the dish.
guide.example: Tap a Sprinter that has stopped growing and read what limits it.

watchFor: The limit line: it names what is holding an organism back right now.
